ja420:1.1: Bhus' amhi kuddho ti avekkhiyāna na tāva daṇḍaṃ panayeyya issaro, aṭṭhānaso appatirūpam attano parassa dukkhāni bhusaṃ udīraye.
ja420:2.1: Yato ca jāneyya pasādam attano atthaṃ niyuñjeyya parassa dukkataṃ, tadāyam attho ti sayaṃ avekkhiya ath' assa daṇḍaṃ sadisaṃ nivesaye.
ja420:3.1: Na cāpi jhāpeti paraṃ na attanaṃ amucchito yo nayate nayānayaṃ yo daṇḍadhāro bhavatīdha issaro sa vaṇṇagutto siriyā na dhaṃsati.
ja420:4.1: Ye khattiyāse anisammakārino paṇenti daṇḍaṃ sahasā pamucchitā avaṇṇasaṃyuttā jahanti jīvitaṃ, ito vimuttāpi ca yanti duggatiṃ.
ja420:5.1: Dhamme ca ye ariyapavedite ratā (Cfr. Dhp. v. anuttarā te vacasā manasā kammanā ca, te santisoraccasamādhisaṇṭhitā vajanti lokaṃ dubhayaṃ tathāvidhā.
ja420:6.1: Rājāham asmi narapamadānam issaro, sace pi kujjhāmi ṭhapemi attanaṃ, nisedhayanto janataṃ tathāvidhaṃ paṇemi daṇḍaṃ anukampa yoniso ti
ja420:7.1: Siriñ ca lakkhiñ ca tam eva khattiya janādhipa mā vijahi kudācanaṃ, akkodhano niccapasannacitto anīgho tuvaṃ vassasatāni pālaya.
ja420:8.1: Guṇehi etehi upeta khattiya ṭhitamariyavattī suvaco akodhano sukhī anuppīḷa pasāsa mediniṃ, ito vimutto pi ca yāhi suggatiṃ.
ja420:9.1: Evaṃ suvinītena subhāsitena dhammena ñāyena upāyaso nayaṃ nibbāpaye saṃkhubhitaṃ mahājanaṃ mahā va megho salilena medinin ti.
